'''Serdarn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was stationed on [[Carrick Station]], where he sold a wide variety of items to the Republic forces aboard.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Serdarn appears in the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Crew Skill Trade vendor.<ref name="TOR" />
